court: In the High Court of Madras†
judges_raw: (Before S.M. Subramaniam and K. Surender, JJ.)
respondents: Secretary to Government Tourism, Culture and Endowments Department, Secretariat, Chennai and Others … Respondent(s).

To direct the respondents 1 to 17 to take appropriate steps to remove the illegal encroachment made in 18th respondent temple properties and secure and safeguard the 18th respondent religious institutions properties by considering petitioner representations dated 28.4.2016, 19.9.2016 and 4.5.2021
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. M.S. Premkumar, Govt. Advocate for R 1 to R 15
Mr. V. Jayaprakash Narayanan for R 16
Mr. V. Udayakumar for R 21, R 22, R 25, R 28, R 32, R 35, R 36 & R 38

judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— Mr V. Jayaprakash Narayanan, learned counsel for the 16th respondent, Commissioner, Chidambaram Municipality, based on instruction, would submit that the writ petitions filed by encroachers were dismissed by this Court on 11-1-2023 in W.P. No. Nos. 12358, 12625 & 12707 of 2022. Thereafter, the HR&CE Department, with the assistance of Revenue Officers and police authorities, have removed the encroachments in entirety in respect of the lands and dwellings falling under the HR & CE Act.

2. The HR&CE Department, since had initiated Section 78 proceedings for eviction of the encroachers, the same was also enforced. The entire encroachments were removed as per the submission made on behalf of the 16th respondent. This being the factum, no further adjudication is required. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands closed.
